name: issue_446_duplicate_index_constraint
description: Dump inlined a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint whose key equals an earlier one in CREATE TABLE, and PostgreSQL silently dropped it
notes: transformIndexConstraints (parse_utilcmd.c) removes an index constraint of CREATE TABLE whose index equals an earlier one; ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT keeps it.
The dump keeps the first such constraint inline and adds each duplicate with ALTER TABLE right after the CREATE TABLE, so a plan of the dump against the source database is empty.
The constraint comment follows the ALTER TABLE that creates the constraint.
